premise: Leo's seedling leans to one side and he worries it's poorly — until he sees the solar panel tilting the very same way: both are following the light.
inspiration: Ovid's Clytie, who turns all day to follow the Sun, turned: two followers side by side, a plant and a machine.

en-US.title: Which Way Is Up?
en-US.text: {man:enter} Leo was worried about his little {seedling:enter} seedling. It was leaning. Not straight up, but over to one side, like a sleepy little tree. {seedling:wobble} {man:face sad} [nervously] Was it poorly? Did it need more water? More warmth? {man:live} {sfx:beep} He checked his wrist display. Water: fine. Warmth: fine. Air: fine. {man:shake 0.4} [sighs] Then why was it leaning? Just then he noticed the {solar-panel:enter} solar panel nearby. {man:face surprised} It was leaning too! {solar-panel:live} Tilting, very slowly, toward the Sun. [gasps] Leo looked from one to the other. {man:pulse} The panel was following the sunlight. And so was his seedling. {seedling:live} It stretched up and opened a new leaf, right toward the light. {man:face happy} [laughs] {man:hop} Nothing was wrong at all. They were both just doing their jobs. {solar-panel:glow 0.5} {seedling:sparkle} [warmly] Finding the light. Every single day.

es-ES.title: ¿Hacia dónde es arriba?
es-ES.text: {man:enter} Leo estaba preocupado por su pequeño {seedling:enter} brote. Se inclinaba. No hacia arriba, sino hacia un lado, como un arbolito con sueño. {seedling:wobble} {man:face sad} [nervously] ¿Estaría malito? ¿Necesitaba más agua? ¿Más calor? {man:live} {sfx:beep} Miró la pantalla de su muñeca. Agua: bien. Calor: bien. Aire: bien. {man:shake 0.4} [sighs] Entonces, ¿por qué se inclinaba? Justo entonces se fijó en el {solar-panel:enter} panel solar de al lado. {man:face surprised} ¡También se inclinaba! {solar-panel:live} Se giraba, muy despacio, hacia el Sol. [gasps] Leo miró a uno y a otro. {man:pulse} El panel seguía la luz del sol. Y su brote, también. {seedling:live} Se estiró y abrió una hoja nueva, directa hacia la luz. {man:face happy} [laughs] {man:hop} No pasaba nada malo. Los dos estaban haciendo su trabajo. {solar-panel:glow 0.5} {seedling:sparkle} [warmly] Buscar la luz. Todos los días.
